## Key Projects
- **Ever Ready to Release (Intel Internal)**: Architected and deployed an LLM-powered retrieval workflow using LangChain to map code changes with relevant validation test cases, reducing validation time by 30% and infrastructure usage by ~20%. Tech: Python, LangChain, LLMs, Vector Databases, C++, MLflow.
- **AI-Powered Data Analysis & Insights Platform**: End-to-end analytics platform integrating ML, deep learning, and Gemini AI for automated exploratory data analysis. Tech: Python, Streamlit, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Gemini AI, Plotly. Repository: https://github.com/arastuthakur/Data-Analysis-Insights-Platform
- **MRI Image Denoiser**: Residual autoencoder with self-attention mechanisms for MRI image denoising, achieving ~18% PSNR improvement and <200 ms latency. Tech: TensorFlow, Autoencoders, Self-Attention. Repository: https://github.com/arastuthakur/mri-image-denoiser
- **dibidb**: High-performance, lightweight embedded database engine in Python. Repository: https://github.com/arastuthakur/dibidb
